messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up folks — eng-infra rollout plan for CI/CD + auth consolidation. We're migrating from Jenkins + local GitHub tokens to GitHub Actions + Okta SSO for org access. Migration window: Apr 12 22:00 UTC -> Apr 13 06:00 UTC (6–8h).
Alex Kim: Is this a hard outage or just reduced deploy capacity?
Priya Singh: Mostly reduced capacity. Builds will queue; critical hotfix deploys can be scheduled in the maintenance window with SRE approval.
Jordan Lee: Do existing Jenkins jobs get auto-migrated?
Priya Singh: Short answer: no. We'll provide a migration script that translates simple declarative jobs to Actions workflows. Complex scripted pipelines will need manual porting. See: https://go.redwood.internal/infra/ci-migration (internal doc).
Sam (engops): Action items for teams: 1) Ensure repos have CODEOWNERS and branch protection enabled. 2) Remove hard-coded PATs from repo secrets (use org secrets). 3) Test GH Actions in a staging org (we'll provide)."Ownerless" repos — ping infra.
Lena Park: Security checklist from SecOps: rotate personal tokens by Apr 10; enable 2FA; add SCIM groups to Okta. We'll force-enforce SSO after the migration window.
Alex Kim: How do we rotate tokens safely? Any script?
Priya Singh: Use this helper: `scripts/rotate-tokens.sh` (will be pushed to the infra-utils repo). Steps: `gh auth login --with-token`, create org-level secret via `gh secret set CI_PAT -b"" < new_token`. We'll publish a step-by-step guide in the wiki.
deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled by Priya Singh: org-wide CI migration on 2024-04-12 22:00 UTC. Estimated 6 hours. :warning:
Jordan Lee: Will Actions runners be managed or self-hosted?
Priya Singh: Hybrids: hosted runners for small repos; self-hosted GPU/large runners via Dedicated infra for heavy workloads. We'll publish runner labels and quotas soon.
Sam (engops): Jira migration note — unrelated but happening same month: project keys will change for a few legacy repos. We'll coordinate cross-team so GH Actions job names referencing Jira keys are updated. Expect follow-ups.
Alex Kim: If my repo uses a custom Docker image published to our internal registry, any change?
Priya Singh: No change to registry access. Just ensure Actions workflows authenticate via `GITHUB_TOKEN` or org secret credentials. We'll add examples for `docker/login-action`.
Lena Park: One more security thing — ephemeral creds policy for self-hosted runners will be enforced. No long-lived machine accounts.
Priya Singh: Migration support: office-hours: Apr 8–11 16:00–18:00 PT in #eng-infra and a dedicated Zoom. We'll have a migration helper channel `#ci-migration-help`. Please open tickets for repos needing manual migration.
Jordan Lee: Cool. Any rollback plan if Actions config breaks org-wide?
Priya Singh: Yes — fallback is to re-enable Jenkins agents for a sub-set of repos and revert the repo-level changes we push. We'll coordinate with SRE to spin up temporary Jenkins capacity if needed.
Sam (engops): I'll post the exact impact matrix (which repos get repo-level changes, which get only runner settings) by EOD tomorrow.
Alex Kim: Thanks — will book time in office-hours.
Priya Singh: Thanks everyone. Actionables pinned: rotate tokens by Apr 10; test GH Actions in staging; join office-hours; move any secrets to org-level secrets. Ping me @Priya if your team has >100 concurrent builds or special runner needs. :rocket:
